'''Kambadur Muralidhar''' or '''K. Muralidhar''' is an Indian biologist, known for his work in biochemistry, endocrinology and reproductive biology. He taught at [[Delhi University]] for over thirty years, and was Head of its Department of Zoology. Currently, he is Jawaharlal Nehru Chair Professor, School of Life Sciences, [[University of Hyderabad]]. He is a Fellow of the [[Indian National Science Academy]],<ref name="insa">{{cite web|title=INSA :: Indian Fellow Detail|url=http://www.insaindia.res.in/detail/N95-1181|website=insaindia.res.in|accessdate=24 February 2018}}</ref> the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]]<ref name="ias">{{cite web|title=Fellow Profile: Muralidhar, Prof. Kambadur|url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Muralidhar,_Prof._Kambadur|website=Indian Academy of Sciences|accessdate=24 February 2018}}</ref> and the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]].<ref name="nasi">{{cite web|title=The National Academy of Sciences, India - Fellows|url=http://www.nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=M|website=nasi.org.in|accessdate=24 February 2018|archive-date=27 December 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101227133632/http://www.nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=M|url-status=dead}}</ref> He is also highly regarded as a teacher and educator, and has contributed to biology education at both high school and college levels.

== Early life ==
Kambadur Muralidhar was born on 25 December 1948 in [[Coimbatore]], [[Tamil Nadu]]. After early schooling in several different places in Tamil Nadu and [[Andhra Pradesh]], he graduated from St John's High School, [[Bellary]], [[Karnataka]].<ref name="biotechinterview">{{cite news|title=Dr Kambadur Muralidhar - interview|url=http://kashbiotech.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/Dr-kambadur-muralidhar-interview.pdf|accessdate=25 February 2018|work=Biotech Express|date=August 2015}}</ref> He obtained his Bachelor's and master's degrees in chemistry from [[Osmania University]], [[Hyderabad]]. He went to the [[Indian Institute of Science]], [[Bangalore]], for his doctoral studies, where he worked with the well-known biochemist and endocrinologist [[Nuggehalli Raghuveer Moudgal|N. R. Moudgal]], and completed his Ph.D. in 1976. For his doctoral work, he was awarded the Professor K. V. Giri Memorial Gold Medal.<ref name="insa" />

== Career ==
In August 1976, immediately after completing his Ph.D., Muralidhar joined the faculty of the newly established [[University of Hyderabad]] as Lecturer. After a postdoctoral stint at [[State University of New York|SUNY]], [[Buffalo, New York]], he moved to the [[University of Delhi]] as Reader in 1983. Subsequently, he became Professor. In 1989 and 1990, he had visiting assignments at the [[University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center|M D Anderson Cancer Center]], Texas, USA. He was Head, Department of Zoology, during 2001–2004. After his retirement in December 2013, he joined [[South Asian University]], New Delhi, as J. C. Bose National Fellow. In January 2017 he moved back to the University of Hyderabad as Jawaharlal Nehru Chair Professor.<ref name="uohydlecture">{{cite web |title=Jawaharlal Nehru Chair Lecture Series |url=http://sls.uohyd.ac.in/lectures_seminars/Muralidhar1.pdf |website=sls.uohyd.ac.in |publisher=University of Hyderabad |accessdate=24 June 2019 |archive-date=8 September 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170908101705/http://sls.uohyd.ac.in/lectures_seminars/Muralidhar1.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Role as educator ==
Apart from his work as a researcher, Muralidhar is highly regarded as a teacher and educator. He advocates an integrated approach to the teaching of biology at both high school and college level, which he has elaborated in an interview.<ref name="biotechinterview" /> He has also articulated his views on the nature of science and its relation to biology education in a lecture, published by [[Indian National Science Academy|INSA]] as part of the volume ''Frontier Lectures in Biology''.<ref name="insalectures">{{cite book|editor-last1=Saidapur|editor-first1=S. K. |title=Frontier Lectures In Biology|date=May 2015|publisher=Indian National Science Academy|pages=34–47|url=https://www.insaindia.res.in/scroll_news_pdf/e-book.pdf|accessdate=15 March 2018}}</ref> He was the Chairman of a [[University Grants Commission (India)|UGC]] committee for curricular reform in Zoology, and authored a report that is considered to be a benchmark.<ref name="insa" /> He was also the Chief Advisor of the biology textbooks published by [[National Council of Educational Research and Training|NCERT]] in 2006–2008.<ref name="ncertbio12">{{cite book|title=Biology: Textbook for class XII|date=2006|publisher=National Council of Educational Research and Training|location=New Delhi|url=http://www.ncert.nic.in/NCERTS/l/lebo1ps.pdf|accessdate=1 March 2018}}</ref>

* Fellow, Indian National Science Academy (elected 1995)<ref name="insa" />

* Jawaharlal Nehru Chair Professor, [[University of Hyderabad]] (2017)
